title: Gaia Early Data Release 3: The Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars

source_identity.catalogue_scope: Gaia EDR3 nearby-star catalogue, reported within 100 pc in the source paper

available_candidate_observables: astrometric parallax and related quality fields
sky position and derived three-dimensional position after distance treatment
not_directly_supplied_as_target: complete baryonic mass density rho_3D in kg/m^3
universal mass per source for the selected volume
data_scope.candidate_use: 3D stellar-structure source candidate for an explicit mass-realization operator

required_steps: freeze catalogue query and column selection
record coordinate transform and finite-volume binning
compute and hash the local extracted table

mass_calibration.reason: a 3D stellar-position catalogue is not by itself a calibrated total mass-density field
required_items: independent calibration or source-locked mass model

fit_policy.reason: metadata-only candidate with no local raw table, calibration, uncertainty, or holdout package

required_before_unlock: freeze observable operator and source query
freeze all model parameters or calibration policy
separate calibration and holdout source regions/rows

claim_boundary: Gaia/GCNS is a candidate 3D stellar-structure source; it does not close C-to-rho_3D, total-mass calibration, galaxy dynamics, or dark-matter claims.
next_controller: execute the locked query, archive and hash the returned local source table, then close selection, mass calibration, uncertainty, and holdout gates before any physical fit
